items.title: Musk says US government may be behind slowdown of Ukraine drone speeds
items.summary: Ukraine says Starlink access has improved but it is still facing speed limits which are disrupting its battlefield "missions".

items.title: We are behind you and that will not change, PM tells Zelensky
items.summary: The Ukrainian president visited London in an effort to bolster support among European allies following a row with Donald Trump.

items.title: Russell Brand was a 'sexual predator', prosecution alleges as rape trial begins
items.summary: The actor and comedian has pleaded not guilty to three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault and one of indecent assault.

items.title: Sally Rooney books withdrawn in UK over Palestine Action support
items.summary: The Irish writer is best known for novels such as Normal People, Intermezzo and Conversations With Friends.

items.title: Drop-off charges at UK airports to be reviewed after sharp increase
items.summary: Confirming the review, the government said it was "vital to ensure travel remains accessible and that passengers are treated fairly".

items.title: Reform faces criticism after councillors filmed making racist comments

items.title: What we know about the Pope's lung cancer diagnosis
